prompts.prompt:
Extract the following fields from this Argentine Carta de Porte
Electrónica (electronic grain waybill) and return ONLY a valid JSON
object with this exact structure, no extra text:

{
  "fecha": "",
  "nro_ctg": "",
  "vencimiento": "",
  "seccion_a_intervinientes": {
    "titular": "",
    "remitente_comercial": "",
    "destinatario": "",
    "destino": "",
    "transportista": "",
    "flete_pagador": "",
    "chofer": ""
  },
  "seccion_b_grano_especie": {
    "grano": "",
    "tipo": "",
    "campaña": "",
    "peso_bruto": 0,
    "peso_tara": 0,
    "peso_neto": 0
  },
  "seccion_c_procedencia": {
    "planta": "",
    "direccion": "",
    "localidad": "",
    "provincia": "",
    "lat": "",
    "long": ""
  },
  "seccion_d_destino_mercaderia": "",
  "seccion_e_transporte": {
    "patentes": "",
    "partida": "",
    "kms": 0,
    "tarifa": 0
  },
  "seccion_g_descarga": ""
}

This document may be a scanned image with OCR noise - do your best to
read it. "nro_ctg" typically follows the format NNNNN-NNNNNNN (CTG
number). If a field is not present or illegible, use an empty string
(or 0 for numeric fields).
